US diplomats instructed to replace 'AI' with 'super intelligence' after Trump’s UN remarks

President Donald Trump, speaking at the United Nations, referred to artificial intelligence as “super intelligence.” Following the remarks, the U.S. State Department instructed American diplomats to use the term “super intelligence” instead of “AI” in official communications. The change was reported by multiple outlets, and commentators noted ongoing debates about AI control, global guardrails, and the terminology’s political reception.
